description: Hand-authored synthetic diagnostic fixture, not held-out data or an official benchmark. Expected paths indicate supporting notes, not generated answers. Includes lexical controls, temporal distractors, cross-note evidence, and multilingual queries.

notes.10_Projects/atlas-incidents.md:
# Atlas incident log

On 2026-01-08, Atlas requests timed out because the Redis connection pool was exhausted.

On 2026-02-12, Atlas latency increased because the DNS resolver failed. Increasing the Redis pool did not resolve this later incident.
notes.10_Projects/atlas-decisions.md:
# Atlas decisions

On 2026-01-09, Atlas adopted request coalescing to merge duplicate concurrent requests.

On 2026-02-13, Atlas replaced its DNS resolver after the February incident. The decision did not remove request coalescing.
notes.10_Projects/orion-owner.md:
# Orion ownership

Orion is maintained by Mira.

Mira approved the current Orion deployment.
notes.20_Areas/mira-team.md:
# Mira profile

Mira works in the Helios team.

Helios handles production reliability.
notes.10_Projects/orion-storage.md:
# Orion storage history

Previous configuration: Orion stored checkpoints in SQLite until 2026-03-01.

Current configuration: Orion stores checkpoints in PostgreSQL after 2026-03-01.
notes.10_Projects/lyra-storage.md:
# Lyra storage

Current configuration: Lyra stores checkpoints in SQLite.

Lyra is maintained by Niko, not Mira.
notes.10_Projects/cedar.md:
# Cedar registry

Cedar depends on the Nimbus library.

Cedar does not depend on Cirrus.
notes.30_Resources/nimbus.md:
# Nimbus compatibility

Nimbus supports the Rust language.

Nimbus does not support the Go language.
notes.30_Resources/cirrus.md:
# Cirrus compatibility

Cirrus supports the Go language.

Cirrus is used by Birch, not Cedar.
notes.20_Areas/security.md:
# Security policy

Production API credentials must be stored in the operating system keyring. Never put secrets in plain text config files.

Credential rotation is required after suspected exposure.
notes.20_Areas/vietnamese.md:
# Quy tắc vận hành

Khi thay đổi cấu hình gateway, phải khởi động lại dịch vụ trước khi kiểm tra.

Luôn ghi lại quyết định kiến trúc và lý do thay đổi.
notes.20_Areas/english.md:
# Runtime operations

After modifying gateway configuration, restart the service before verification.

The runtime operation handbook is maintained by Vera.
notes.10_Projects/aurora.md:
# Aurora release

Aurora was released on 2026-04-10.

Aurora version 2.1 requires Python 3.12.
notes.10_Projects/borealis.md:
# Borealis release

Borealis was released on 2026-04-11.

Borealis version 2.1 requires Python 3.11.
notes.30_Resources/backup.md:
# Backup runbook

The production backup retention period is 14 days.

The staging backup retention period is 3 days.
notes.30_Resources/logging.md:
# Logging policy

Use tracing for Rust diagnostic events.

Use anyhow to propagate application errors.
notes.30_Resources/redis.md:
# Redis tuning

Redis connection pool sizing controls the number of concurrent connections. Redis latency can also increase during snapshot creation.
notes.30_Resources/dns.md:
# DNS reference

A DNS resolver translates hostnames into addresses. DNS timeout symptoms can resemble network packet loss.
notes.30_Resources/sqlite.md:
# SQLite reference

SQLite is an embedded relational database. SQLite checkpoints affect write performance.
notes.30_Resources/postgres.md:
# PostgreSQL reference

PostgreSQL supports transactions and relational queries. PostgreSQL checkpoint settings require monitoring.
notes.20_Areas/niko.md:
# Niko profile

Niko works in the Selene team. Selene manages Lyra.
notes.10_Projects/birch.md:
# Birch registry

Birch depends on Cirrus. Birch deployment is approved by Niko.
notes.30_Resources/python.md:
# Python reference

Python 3.12 and Python 3.11 are separate runtime versions. Release compatibility should be tested before deployment.
notes.30_Resources/request.md:
# Request handling

Concurrent requests can cause duplicate work. A cache can serve repeated requests after completion, but does not necessarily merge work in flight.
notes.30_Resources/keyring.md:
# Keyring reference

The operating system keyring stores credentials. Keyring availability depends on the session environment.
notes.20_Areas/retention.md:
# Data retention

Log retention is 30 days in production. Log retention is 7 days in staging. This policy does not specify backup retention.
